description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractSamplingService' that provides a mechanism for sampling performance metrics based on a configurable sampling rate. It manages sample counters per key, triggers sampling when conditions are met, and includes hooks for subclass-specific actions.

classes.name: AbstractSamplingService
classes.description: An abstract class providing a sampling mechanism with configurable rate, managing counters, and allowing subclasses to implement specific sampling actions.

methods.name: AbstractSamplingService
methods.description: Constructor that initializes sampling rate, with validation to ensure it is at least 1.

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Overloaded methods to perform sampling with a Runnable or a Supplier, determining whether to take a sample based on internal counters.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Clears counter map and calls subclass-specific reset actions.

methods.name: doReset
methods.description: Protected hook for subclasses to implement additional cleanup logic during reset.

methods.name: takeSample
methods.description: Abstract method; subclasses implement this to define how to take a sample with a key and duration.
